newsitem.title: PERU: Uruguay plans $300 mln bond issue June - Barings.
newsitem.headline: Uruguay plans $300 mln bond issue June - Barings.

text.p: The government of Uruguay plans a $300 million international bond issue in June, the largest in its history, said Arturo Porzecanski, managing director and chief economist of ING Barings in New York.

"The government has charged us with making its biggest bond issue, some $300 million," Porzecanski told reporters in Lima. "We are going (to Uruguay) in order to finalize the details. These bonds are going to come out in the next few weeks, in the month of June, I think."
Porzecanski said the issue would have a maturity of 30 years. He did not give more details of the type of issue or its interest rates.
He added that so far in 1997, Latin American governments and private companies have made debt issues totalling a "record figure" of $20 billion. In 1996, the year's total was $53 billion, he added.
